archetype: 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) tailored for Corporate Premium (Old Money Tech)
design_philosophy: Clean, professional B2B aesthetic with high-contrast typography, deep navy structural elements, and vibrant blue accents for interaction. Seamlessly bridges an artful marketing presence with a highly functional, data-dense candidate dashboard.

marketing_page.grid_strategy: Tetris Bento Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8). Use asymmetry for visual tension.

dashboard.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6). Dense, utilitarian layout.

icons.instructions: Use lucide-react for all UI icons. Keep stroke width consistent (default 2px). For dashboard sidebar, use 20px icons.

testing.instructions: ALL interactive elements MUST include a descriptive data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the marketing page using custom HTML/Tailwind to allow for fluid bento layouts and overlapping elements. Avoid rigid Shadcn wrappers here.
For the Candidate Login and Dashboard, utilize Shadcn UI components heavily (Inputs, Cards, Badges, Tabs, Dropdowns) for maximum accessibility and standard SaaS UX.
Do NOT use pure black (#000000). Use the provided Deep Navy (#0A192F) or Slate 900 (#0F172A) for high-contrast dark elements.
Ensure the application form on the home page and login forms are completely functional in UI (mocked Firebase logic is fine for now, but UI states must exist).
On the dashboard, implement the 'Control Room Grid' with 4 stat cards at the top, a main 'My Applications' table/list, and a 'Recent Activity' / 'Profile Completion' sidebar.
Incorporate pill-shaped badges for job tags (Full-time, Remote) and application statuses (Under review, Interview) as requested by the user.
Mocked interactive elements (like Google/LinkedIn OAuth buttons) must look fully polished with proper hover states.
Use standard `.js` files for React components, not `.tsx`.
